_class_crops_doc: Per-class crops with FULL coverage (train+val+test_field examples). These are the (crop, disease) pairs the model is empirically validated to detect with measured field performance. The app should expose only these pairs in its disease-detection UI.
_class_crops_train_only_doc: Per-class crops with train+val examples but ZERO test_field examples — the model has SEEN these (crop, disease) pairs during training but their field-deployment performance is unverified. Treat predictions on these pairs with lower confidence and flag them for manual review until test data is collected.
_supported_crops_doc: Crops with at least one DISEASE class (excluding healthy) having full train+val+test coverage. The app should expose disease-detection workflows only for these 5 crops. Peach is healthy-only (see healthy_only_crops). Cherry is train-only and NOT recommended for production routing.
_healthy_only_crops_doc: Crops where ONLY the 'healthy' class has full train+val+test coverage. The app should accept photos of these crops for healthy-vs-not classification but should NOT route them to disease-specific advice flows. Peach has 1,957 training bacterial_spot images but no test_field bacterial_spot images, so peach disease detection is unverified.
_crops_doc: All crops the model has been exposed to in any data split. Cherry has 1,740+ training images (580 healthy + 743 powdery_mildew + 131 val healthy + 155 val PM) but ZERO test_field examples — predictions on cherry inputs are technically possible but field performance is unverified.

test_time_augmentation.description: For best accuracy at inference, run forward twice (original + horizontal flip), average the softmax. ~+0.5pp.

inference_confidence_thresholds.rationale: Calibrated on cleaned 510-img test. Mean confidence on correct predictions ≈0.85, on incorrect ≈0.53. The gap supports threshold-based routing.

training_data_distribution._doc: Per-class per-crop training row counts derived from data/processed/splits_v15_clean_balanced.csv joined to v6_pool_manifest.csv. Use this to interpret the labels.json claims against the actual model exposure. 'unk' rows are PV/PD images whose original-path crop annotation didn't match a known crop string (often PD plantdoc_test/<class>/<file> paths where class doesn't encode crop).
